findings.explanation: HOL4 requires ∀v ty. type_ok tysig ty ⇒ σ (v,ty) <: typesem δ τ ty. Lean has ∃ v ty of the same implication. Any ty that is not type_ok satisfies that implication vacuously, so the predicate is trivially true whenever some type is ill-formed. For tysig = FEMPTY the witness is Tyapp "x" [], so it holds for every σ. With mem = (λx y. F) the HOL4 predicate is false there, because Tyvar a is type_ok. The error propagates to is_valuation0, satisfies0, models0, entails0 and is_structure0, which then quantify over valuations that are not well-typed.
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics

namespace Candle
open HOL Classical

example : ∃ (mem : Unit → Unit → Prop) (δ : tyass Unit) (τ : tyval Unit) (σ : tmval Unit),
    is_term_valuation0 mem (FEMPTY : fmap mlstring Nat) δ τ σ ∧
    ¬ (∀ (v : mlstring) (ty : type), type_ok (FEMPTY : fmap mlstring Nat) ty →
        mem (σ (v, ty)) (typesem δ τ ty)) := by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ _ => (), fun _ => (), fun _ => (), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨mls "x", Tyapp (mls "x") [], fun h => ?_⟩
    rw [type_ok] at h
    have h1 := h.1
    have hn : ¬ (mls "x" ∈ FDOM (FEMPTY : fmap mlstring Nat)) := by
      intro hm
      exact (show (FEMPTY : fmap mlstring Nat).rep (mls "x") ≠ none from hm) rfl
    unfold FLOOKUP at h1
    rw [if_neg hn] at h1
    cases h1
  · intro h
    exact h (mls "x") (Tyvar (mls "a")) (by simp [type_ok])

end Candle
findings.hol4_check: !(d:mlstring -> 'a list -> 'a) (t:mlstring -> 'a) (s:mlstring # type -> 'a). ~is_term_valuation0 (\(x:'a) (y:'a). F) (FEMPTY:mlstring |-> num) d t s
